description: This is an interface that defines configuration options for AWS STS regional endpoints, specifying methods to retrieve the endpoints type and the entire configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for accessing AWS STS regional endpoints configuration options.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the type of endpoints (e.g., 'regional', 'legacy') used by the configuration.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the entire configuration as an associative array.
